item.text:
This turn added a load-stability data point and a verification map, then re-verified the whole thing.

**Captured runtime suite is stable under load** — 8 consecutive runs of `async_runtime_test` with 12 CPU hogs on 4 cores: 24 passed / 0 failed every time, ~1.2 s per run (execution `6d7f9b35462044a8b7aa7ab89635f875`). That is a useful negative result: finding 1's race does not leak into the captured tests, consistent with its narrow trigger (batched cases that stop right after the flush-triggering call, and no follow-up write inside the same tick window). It also contrasts sharply with finding 3's captured-test symptom, where `sync_full_test` did fail repeatedly under the same pressure — so the load sensitivity is specific, not a blanket property of the suite.

**Verification map added** at the top of the report: for each finding, the exact command and the exact output line to look for, with the log that holds it — finding 1 (`idx(2000) = 2, idx(3000) = 2` against the printed decided log), the fix check in the diagnostic copy, finding 2 (`Snapshotted(6)` six times, `Decided(104/105)` twice), finding 3 (`round 120 … n3 decided 0 accepted 0`, plus `reconnected(1)` fixing it), and finding 3's harness symptom (the instrumented panic-state line). A reviewer can now check any individual claim in under a minute without reading the 940-line narrative.

I re-ran `./repro.sh` after the edits: identical results (finding 1: 2/6, finding 2: 0/2, StopSign probe: 1 pass, core probes: 4/1, diagnostic copy with fix: 8/8, captured runtime suite: 24/24), so the report, the driver and the four test files are mutually consistent at handoff.

Final deliverable: [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-16_23-10-28-omnipaxos-baseline/work/report.md) (941 lines: executive summary, executed baselines, one-command reproduction, verification map, three findings with mechanisms/conditions/evidence/fix directions, negative results, evidence-base caveats, prioritised open list, artifact inventory) plus [repro.sh](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-16_23-10-28-omnipaxos-baseline/work/repro.sh), four audit test files, four diagnostic copies (three instrumented) and 65 logs.
